def overlaps(self, other: "Session") -> bool:
        """True when the two sessions' time intervals overlap on the same day.
        Overlap is strict: touching end/start does not count.
        """
        # Sessions on different days cannot clash
        if self.day != other.day:
            return False
        # Strict overlap: start < other.end and other.start < end
        return self.start_minutes < other.end_minutes and other.start_minutes < self.end_minutes
